lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.19 - A Listen and read Audio track 88

details: Listen and read develops both reading comprehension and listening skills through a LETS-based activity recycling vocabulary from the unit.
Look for eye movement as students read and careful listening as they follow the text on the page.
“I’m a musician. I want to make some new instruments. Do you think I could make an instrument out of a carrot?”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.19 - B. Choose the correct answers

details: Choose the correct answers tests understanding of the text using picture and word based MC questions.
Look for correct answers and neat circling in students’ books.
“I did it! What could I make out of a pumpkin?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:
Check and encourage Ss to complete the project prompts so that they are ready to present by lesson 7,

Homework Set:
Complete an example of the homework to check Ss understanding. Have Ss then write the homework page, activity and plan in their diaries. 
Leaderboard:
Show the Leaderboard and congratulate / encourage daily app practise.

lessonPlan.topic: Phonics Book P.109 - A Listen and say Audio track 141

details: Listen and say the sounds develops phonics and listening skills by practising the vowel combinations ‘a_e’ and ‘i_e’ inside words.
Look for confident repetition of the words and careful pronunciation of all words

“Today, I really want to go and fly my kite! And then I want to eat some cake.
Have kite can cake got the same spelling? Let’s learn about more words that use these same sounds.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
